featured.title: Swyx · AI Engineer 概念提出者、Latent Space 主理人（曾任 Cognition / Temporal）
featured.summaryEn: Swyx offered a sharp framing this week, extending Jevons paradox beyond software demand to all knowledge work. He argues that if you only understood Jevons paradox in the context of software demand under agentic engineering, you may not have fully internalized its impact under two conditions: humans who can wield coding agents well (AI Engineers), and coding agents breaking containment into all other knowledge work. As the efficiency of labor goes up and the unit cost of knowledge work broadly goes down, demand fo…
featured.insightZh: Swyx 这周把「Jevons 悖论」从软件需求延伸到了整个知识工作领域，观点很值得看。他说如果你只是从「agentic 编程时代软件需求上升」这个角度理解 Jevons 悖论，那你可能还没真正内化它的威力。真正的条件有两个：一是能熟练驾驭 coding agent 的人（也就是 AI Engineer），二是 coding agent「破圈」蔓延到所有其他知识工作。当单位劳动效率上升、知识工作的单位成本普遍下降时，对总工作量和更高质量知识的需求是上升的，而不是下降。他给了一句很狠的判断：「发生在编程身上的事不是例外，而是先兆（herald）。」

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux hyped GPT 5.6 Sol this week, directly addressing prior user complaints about speed, code slop, and frontend quality. He pitched four selling points: fast and token efficient, hardcore at back-end dev, great at front-end, and "does not use useEffect everywhere" — a clear jab at frontend pain points. More practically, he shared a way to use Sol without installing the Codex app: via CLIProxyAPI, point Claude Code at gpt-5.6-sol with a `claudex` alias (bundling subagent model, effor…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 这周为 GPT 5.6 Sol 造势，直接回应了此前用户对模型的各种抱怨：速度、代码质量差（code slop）、前端质量。他列了 Sol 的四个卖点：快且 token 高效、后端开发很硬核、前端也很强、而且「不会到处乱用 useEffect」——最后一条明显是在戳前端开发者的痛点。更实用的是，他还给了一个不用装 Codex app 就能用上 Sol 的办法：通过 CLIProxyAPI 让 Claude Code 指向 gpt-5.6-sol，定义一个叫 `claudex` 的 alias（附带 subagent model、effort、并发等环境变量配置），5 分钟搞定。他还半开玩笑说「如果被封了我给你 reset 补偿」。

featured.title: Booking.com CEO Glenn Fogel 谈 AI 时代的旅行
featured.summaryEn: In a business as complex and highly regulated as travel, AI is an amplifier, not a moat-killer — "There is no such thing as a moat. The only way to win long term is to continue to develop new services, new ways to do things." Glenn Fogel is CEO of Booking Holdings (Priceline's parent), who joined in 2000 when the stock had cratered to $1 and faced delisting, and rode it to a $180B peak — up a thousandfold over 25 years. His view on AI and travel is refreshingly contrarian: when OpenAI briefly tested in-ChatGPT travel checkout and then killed it (Booking jumped 8% on the news), Fogel said not to read too much into it either way. He frames AI as a tool to serve two customer types (travelers and partners) "easier, cheaper, and better" — not a threat. His most convincing argument is scale and complexity. Priceline's agentic system Penny has doubled adoption monthly, lifting conversion and c…
featured.insightZh: 在旅行这样高度复杂、强监管的行业里，AI 不是护城河的终结者而是放大器——「根本没有护城河这回事，你唯一能长期赢的办法就是每天都在开发新服务、新做法」。 Glenn Fogel 是 Booking Holdings（Priceline 母公司）的 CEO，2000 年公司市值几乎归零、股价跌到 1 美元濒临退市时加入，一路做到市值峰值 1800 亿美元、25 年涨了一千倍。他对 AI 与旅行的看法冷静得反潮流：当 OpenAI 一度试水 ChatGPT 内购旅行、又取消该功能时，Booking 股价一度大涨 8%，但 Fogel 说「不要过度解读这件事」。他把 AI 定位为让公司「更容易、更便宜、更好地」服务两类客户（旅行者和合作伙伴）的工具，而不是威胁。 他最有说服力的论据是规模和复杂度。Priceline 的 agentic 系统 Penny 采用率过去几个月每月翻倍，带来了转化率提升、搜索更快、取消率下降。但他坦承绝对量还很小——去年公司做了 1860 亿美元的旅行交易、超 10 亿间夜，Penny 还没被「真正全力推」，因为 token 成本和 ROI 都还没算清楚。他反复强调旅行业最难的不是把库存塞进数据库（「谁都能做，那不算什么」），而是全球日益复杂的监管框架——想做旅行的 merchant of record 得遵守一大堆规则，这才是大玩家的真实门槛。 关于就业，Fogel 举了自己公司的真实例子：2005 年 booking.com 的 40 种语言翻译和客服全靠人力，机器翻译普及后「那些岗位全没了」。他最担心的是变化速度——新岗位创造赶不上旧岗位消失的速度，以及那些无法转型的人（他常想到「50 岁的卡车司机」）。他的应对是持续给员工做 upskilling / AI literacy 培训，并呼吁社会更诚实地讨论 AI 对就业的真实影响，别被「AI 会毁掉你的工作」这类带节奏的提问带偏，否则「其他地方（比如中国）不会有这种恐惧，他们会占优势」。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie flagged a counterintuitive pattern: the jobs AI was supposed to replace are expanding — software job postings are outpacing other fields. His explanation follows Jevons logic: lower the cost of producing something with many use cases, and people want more of it. As software's unit cost drops, people and companies light up more software projects than ever. But because the job isn't fully automated (and likely won't be for as far out as we can see), you still need people who understand these syst…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 观察到一个反直觉的现象：本应被 AI 替代的岗位反而在扩张——软件类岗位招聘增速超过其他领域。他的解释延续了 Jevons 逻辑：当一个有大量用例的东西生产成本下降，人们就想要生产更多。软件单位成本降低后，人们和公司启动的软件项目比以往任何时候都多，用软件去做各种新事情。但因为这份工作本身没有被完全自动化（而且在可预见的未来也不会），你仍然需要懂这些系统的人去维护代码、决定造什么、长期运行和更新它。他判断这个模式会在很多其他被 AI 降低生产成本的领域重演：「Agent 带来的是丰裕，而不是替代。」

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC president and CEO Garry Tan trained his fire on California's building bottleneck this week. He argued that to supercharge building in California again, you'll need to repeal and reform CEQA (the California Environmental Quality Act). He noted millions of housing units are blocked every year using CEQA, and that housing should be built by-right rather than requiring today's level of review. The post is consistent with his self-described stance as an "SF Dem accelerating the boom loop" — tying housing supply to t…
items.insightZh: YC 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 这周把火力对准了加州的建设瓶颈。他呼吁如果想让加州重新「加速建设」，就必须废除并改革 CEQA（加州环境质量法案）。他指出每年有数百万套住房因为 CEQA 被卡住，主张住房应该「按权利建造」（by-right），而不该经历今天这种层层审查。这条推文延续了他作为「SF Dem、加速 boom loop」的一贯立场——把住房供给和创业生态的活力绑在一起看。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman took his signature tongue-in-cheek approach to promoting GPT 5.6 Sol. He said there are a lot of benchmarks suggesting 5.6 Sol is the best model in the world right now, but the most reliable tell is "that elon is obsessed with me again" — classic Altman self-deprecation and cross-town needling. He also dropped a comment on cost structure, noting that at these levels of usage "30% of the cost was on fable," hinting at internal attention to token economics.
items.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 用他标志性的调侃语气为 GPT 5.6 Sol 站台。他说有很多 benchmark 都显示 5.6 Sol 现在是「世界上最好的模型」，但最可靠的判断方式是「Elon 又开始对我念念不忘了」——一句典型的 Altman 式自嘲兼隔空喊话。他另外还随手抛了一句关于使用成本结构的评论，提到在这种使用量级下「30% 的成本花在 fable 上」，透露了内部对 token 经济学的关注。
